title: Europe Hit by Coordinated Flight Bomb Threats and Cyberattacks on Critical Services
text: Europe Hit by Coordinated Flight Bomb Threats and Cyberattacks on Critical Services Investigations are underway to determine the link between a series of coordinated incidents that disrupted travel and essential services across Europe, including diverted passenger flights and cyberattacks on refrigeration systems for food and medical supplies. Flight bomb threats and cyberattacks disrupt services across Europe as investigators work to identify those responsible. Bomb threats diverted passenger flights across Europe while separate cyberattacks hit supermarket refrigeration systems and plasma-storage sites. As concerns grow about the security of everyday services, investigators are still trying to determine who was behind the incidents and whether they are connected. Why dozens of passenger flights were diverted or escorted by fighter jets after bomb threats. How cyberattacks disrupted refrigeration systems, affecting food supplies and critical medical storage. The unanswered questions about who was responsible and whether the incidents share a common link.SBS News in Depth is a news analysis podcast from SBS, going behind the headlines with reporting and interviews on the stories shaping Australia and the world.
